jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
OVERVIEW:

**Experience** a place of energy, passion, and excitement. A place where the joy of discovery and uncommon artistry blend to create exhilarating buying experiences—for true beauty enthusiasts. At Ulta Beauty, we’re transforming the world one shade, one lash, one cut at a time. Because beauty is powerful.

If you seek **greater purpose**—a place of vision, mission, and lived values—where voices are heard, contributions valued and recognized and growth opportunities abound, consider Ulta Beauty. Nowhere else are the possibilities quite this beautiful.

  
:

**GENERAL SUMMARY & SCOPE**

The Operations Manager (OM) is responsible for leading through Ulta Beauty’s mission, vision, and values in order to develop a high-performing team that consistently delivers top-line sales growth for the store. The OM leads a team of Task Associates and the Merchandise Manager (MM), and is responsible for supporting the management of the operations of a retail store, including realignments, planograms and inventory life cycle-related processes (e.g., cycle counts, damages, testers, Return To Vendors (RTV), Destroy in Field (DIF) and inventory adjustments). This leader drives the store’s retail business through a focus on performance (sales, inventory results, and operational compliance), people (talent acquisition, training and development), and process (standard operating procedures and compliance standards). This position requires a passion for operational excellence, a drive for results, the ability to quickly and efficiently lead through unforeseen complexity, and the ability to lead, influence, and develop their team.

**PRINCIPAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES** (\*Essential Job Functions)

The OM is a champion of Ulta Beauty’s mission, vision, and values, and should demonstrate them skillfully and consistently by performing the following duties and responsibilities of the position (as well as all other projects/duties as assigned):

**Performance**

* Promote a culture of accountability to meet or exceed the store’s goals related to retail and service sales, guest loyalty (including credit), payroll, omni-channel, and retail shrink as set by Ulta Beauty for the store.
* Drive company profitability through operational excellence, top-line sales growth, and expense control.
* Leverage store forecast and payroll budgets to support with store scheduling needs and communicate the needs to the GM to maximize productivity, achieve sales and payroll goals, and complete workload (e.g., realignments, planograms, and ad set processes) on time, and within the payroll budget.
* Review, analyze and react to Ulta Beauty’s financial and operational reporting, including store visit and audit results, regularly and in a timely manner.
* Leverage company programs, tools, and resources to drive improvements to meet Ulta Beauty’s goals for the store.
* Perform makeup applications, skincare analysis, and product demonstrations with guests to drive sales and guest service experience.
* Take the initiative to stay informed regarding new and existing industry trends, products, and services during work time and be knowledgeable about the ingredients and benefits of these trends, products, and services to better serve guests.
* Maintain prompt, regular attendance as the OM and hold store associates accountable to the Ulta Beauty attendance policy.

**People**

* Attract, hire, and retain a diverse team of top talent, and efficiently address any staffing needs and open positions for the store.
* Build a highly engaged team at the store that embodies the Ulta Beauty brand through effective collaboration, open and honest communication, and prioritization of work.
* Create an inclusive environment that inspires and encourages the growth and engagement of associates.
* Support all aspects of manager and associate professional development, including training, providing individualized competency-based feedback and coaching, performance reviews, succession planning, and individual development plans to enable continuous development and drive sales performance.
* Regularly participate in ongoing training, including brand and category education, to enable continuous professional development and drive sales performance.
* Ensure direct reports regularly participate in ongoing training, including brand and category education, to enable continuous professional development and drive sales performance.
* Establish professional vendor partnerships that foster a shared interest in collaboratively delivering on shipment and planogram expectations.
* Model a culture of operational excellence by working alongside the leadership team and by establishing priorities, providing clear direction and support, and sharing best practices.
* Execute the Guest Engagement Leader program flawlessly through business ownership, associate coaching and leading a helpful and friendly guest experience to drive business results across all Annual Performance Goals (APGs) metrics for the store.

**Process**

* Be knowledgeable of and ensure compliance with Ulta Beauty’s policies, procedures, and standards for the store.
* Adhere to and enforce Ulta Beauty’s dress code.
* Ensure the execution of all operational focuses, inclusive of ad set processes, visual sets, planograms, realignments, and inventory life-cycle related processes (e.g., cycle counts, damages, testers, inventory adjustments, RTVs, and DIFs).
* Use the company’s scheduling tool as directed to adjust schedules and manage attendance in-the-moment during manager-on-duty shifts to ensure accurate schedules and reporting.
* Use the company’s task management tool as directed to prioritize and execute store workload, including product and marketing resets, pricing updates, inventory related tasks, cleaning, and replenishment.
* Manage service, boutique, and store supply inventory and ordering processes, ensuring allocated budget is adhered to, and necessary products for services and retail are on hand.
*

jobs.description:
Front is the customer operations platform built for B2B complexity, keeping every team, tool, and customer conversation in sync so companies can scale without losing connection. Others handle simple interactions. Front handles the coordination and context behind complex B2B customer relationships. Over 9,000 companies, including Uber Freight, Navan, and Stripe, rely on Front because it's the only one that can run the operational layer that makes customer-facing work actually succeed.

Backed by Sequoia Capital and Salesforce Ventures, Front has raised $204M from leading venture capital firms and independent investors including top executives at Atlassian, Okta, Qualtrics, Zoom, and PagerDuty. Front has received numerous accolades, including a **Certified Great Place to Work in 2026,** **Top Places to Work by USA Today 2025**, **Y Combinator's list of Top Companies in 2023**, **#4 on Fortune’s Best Workplaces in the Bay Area** ,**Inc. Magazine's 2022 Best Workplaces list**, and **Forbes Best Startup Employers 2022 List**.

As an Account Manager at Front, you will own the commercial health and growth of a portfolio of customers. This is a relationship-driven role where you’ll manage renewals, uncover expansion opportunities, and help customers get more value from Front over time.

You’ll partner closely with a dedicated Customer Success Manager (CSM). While the CSM focuses on product adoption and value realization, you will own the commercial relationship—building trusted relationships with customer stakeholders, navigating complex opportunities, and delivering predictable revenue outcomes. This role is a great fit for someone who combines commercial acumen, customer empathy, and operational rigor.

**What will you be doing?**

* **Own the commercial lifecycle:** Manage renewals and expansion opportunities across a portfolio of core customers, from early planning through negotiation and close.
* **Drive revenue growth:** Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities, run thoughtful discovery, build business cases, negotiate contracts, and close commercial deals.
* **Build trusted customer relationships:** Develop strong relationships with customer stakeholders and understand their goals, challenges, and evolving business needs.
* Position Front’s broader value: Introduce AI capabilities like Autopilot, Professional Services, premium support, and other relevant offerings to help customers automate workflows, accelerate time-to-value, and expand their use of Front.
* **Partner with Customer Success:** Collaborate closely with your mapped CSM to use product usage data, health signals, and customer feedback to drive expansion and mitigate churn risk.
* **Lead strategic account planning:** Create and execute account plans that align customer priorities with Front’s capabilities and identify paths to long-term growth.
* **Maintain operational excellence:** Keep accurate CRM records, manage pipeline, forecast renewals and expansion, and consistently track customer and commercial activity.
* **Collaborate cross-functionally:** Partner with Sales, Support, Product, Marketing, and Services to resolve issues, advocate for customer feedback, and improve the customer experience.

**What skills and experience do you need?**

* **Experience:** 3–5 years in Account Management, Customer Success, or a related commercial role, ideally managing and growing a portfolio of SaaS customers.
* **Commercial acumen:** A track record of owning revenue outcomes, including renewals, upsell, cross-sell, or expansion in a quota-carrying or metrics-driven environment.
* **Customer relationship skills:** Ability to build credibility with a range of stakeholders, understand business priorities, and communicate value clearly.
* **Strategic and consultative approach:** Strong discovery, negotiation, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to connect customer needs to practical solutions.
* **Cross-functional collaboration:** Experience partnering with Customer Success, Support, Product, Services, and other teams to deliver customer and business outcomes.
* **Operational rigor:** Strong organization and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple opportunities, timelines, and stakeholders without losing momentum.
* **Data fluency:** Ability to interpret customer usage, engagement, and health data to prioritize action and make informed commercial decisions.
* AI fluency: Comfort leveraging AI tools and Front’s AI capabilities to improve productivity, identify customer opportunities, and demonstrate value.
* **SaaS experience:** Experience working in B2B SaaS is required; experience with customer experience, support, collaboration, or communications products is a plus.

**Front operates on a hybrid model — we come together in the office each Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday to collaborate and stay connected.**

**What we offer**

* Competitive salary
* Equity (we are post-series D & backed by some of the best VCs in the US)
* Private health insurance, including plan options at no cost to employees
* Paid parental leave
* Flexible time off policy
* Flexibility to work from home Monday and Friday, unless posted as a fully remote role
* Mental health support with Workplace Options
* Family planning support with Maven
* $100 per month Lifestyle Stipend to spend on fitness, health and wellness, and other activities
* Wellness Days - Fronteers get an additional day off on months with no holidays
* Winter Break - Our offices are closed from Christmas to New Year's Day!

*Front provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability. By applying, you acknowledge and agree that you have read and understand the* *California Recruiting Privacy Notice* *&* *EU Privacy Notice*

Compensation Range: $110K - $127K

jobs.description:
### **The Position**

**Instructional Designer**

  
  

**Who We Are**

We’re passionate about delivering on Our Promise to improve the lives of patients and create healthier communities for all. We foster a culture of inclusivity, integrity and creativity while boldly pursuing answers to the world’s most complex health challenges and transforming society.

  
  

**Role Overview**

As an Instructional Designer embedded within either the Launch Excellence or Functional Excellence teams of LSD, you are a professional who specializes in designing and developing effective, high-impact learning experiences. In this role, you will utilize instructional design theories, practices, and methods to create engaging course content and activities that enhance knowledge acquisition and skills development, ensuring the Commercial and Medical Group (CMG) excels in the core and specialized capabilities needed to get more medicines to patients, faster.

  
  

You are responsible for creating compelling learning activities and course content, working with and as subject matter experts to identify training needs, applying instructional design theories and methods, and utilizing multimedia tools to enhance the learning process. You will also conduct instructional research, develop assessment instruments, and maintain project documentation for effective course development.

  
  

Operating under our organization's philosophy of "doing fewer things, better," you will focus your design and development efforts strictly on our top two commercial priorities: Launch & Field Training, and Functional Training (in that exact order). You will work in a tight, collaborative partnership with Squad Business Partners and Learning Business Partners to translate raw business priorities into cutting-edge, scalable capability products. By delivering the right method for the right training, you will build the mindset, confidence, and clinical/business-outcome skills required for our people to achieve true mastery.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Deep understanding of organization and product launches to architect learning solutions that drive skill and capability adoption across diverse job roles
* Work with Squad Business Partners and Learning Business Partners to analyze the target audience and develop learning objectives to solve business needs
* Identify the best instructional methods based on the type of learning objectives using a range of learning theories, and identify relevant delivery methods based on target audience constraints
* Design and develop scalable learning products and compelling content that engages learners, enhances retention, and transfers on time.
* Design and develop practice activities, exercises, and experiential learning to support the transfer of learning into the workplace
* Create a written or performance-basedassessments that measure the learners’ knowledge gain and ability to transfer learning to the workplace in partnership with Data Insights and Measurements team
* Use technologies to develop and deliver scalable learning content, including authoring tools, workflow learning tools, learning management systems, and skill management systems
* Partner with multimedia designers to prototype and develop graphics, video, audio, role plays, simulations, and games)
* Test instructional products to ensure both functional and content quality
* Work with other instructional designers to execute based on deliverables and timelines laid out in project plans
* Maintain project documentation and course folders to easily facilitate future edits and revisions
* Mentor and coach instructional designers to ensure success of projects and support personal development
* Lead, act and live our Operating Principles in all aspects of work
* Complies with all laws, regulations, policies and procedures that govern the conduct of Genentech activities
  

  

**Who You Are:**

* 6-8 years of experience with a BS degree in instructional design, educational technology; or 4-6 years of experience with a masters or doctorate
* Working knowledge of at least one learning theory and related instructional design methods
* Articulate Storyline, HTML and JavaScript programming knowledge ID
* Solid knowledge of course development software and at least one Learning Management System
* Visual design skills (ex Dreamweaver, Photoshop, Illustrator) and ability to storyboard
* Ability to write effective copy, instructional text, audio scripts/video scripts
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications/Experience:**

* Medical, scientific experience in instructional design for training
  

  

**This position is based out of our South San Francisco Genentech Campus.**

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of South San Francisco is $144,400 -$268,200. **Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law.** This position is eligible to earn incentive compensation that is calculated and paid in accordance with the applicable Incentive Compensation Plan for the role. jobs.description:
**Become a part of our caring community**
=========================================

Humana is seeking an experienced Portfolio Management Lead – Population Health to join our National Medicaid Population Health Strategy Organization. This role offers an opportunity to improve the health and well-being of Medicaid members by helping shape and govern the strategies, solutions, capabilities, and operating approaches that address some of the population’s most significant health challenges.  
  
We are building a team of strategic, curious, and result-oriented leaders who thrive in complex environments and are energized by solving meaningful healthcare challenges. Our culture values innovation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning. We seek individuals who combine bold thinking with disciplined execution and are motivated by the opportunity to build new capabilities, influence enterprise decisions, and make a lasting impact on the communities we serve.

The Portfolio Management Lead – Population Health, supports the governance and performance of Humana’s health solutions portfolio. You will establish portfolio practices, integrated visibility, and decision support needed to align investments with member needs, strategic priorities, operational capacity, and expected value.

  

Working across Health Solutions and clinical, operational, analytical, financial, digital, technology, procurement, compliance, and Medicaid market teams, you will coordinate portfolio planning, business-case development, operational-readiness assessments, performance reviews, and lifecycle decisions. The role enables disciplined portfolio decisions but does not own individual solution strategies, outcomes, or operational delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Establish and maintain portfolio governance**, including decision rights, prioritization criteria, lifecycle stages, review gates, escalation pathways, and leadership forums.
* **Build and govern an enterprise platform** with the tools, templates, and workflows to guide solutions from ideation through scale and retirement.
* **Lead annual and multi-year portfolio planning**, translating strategic priorities into integrated solution roadmaps, resource requirements, sequencing recommendations, and decision points.
* **Maintain an integrated portfolio view** of health solutions, performance, resource demand, operational capacity, dependencies, risks, and expected value.
* **Facilitate solution lifecycle decisions** to initiate, validate, implement, scale, optimize, modify, or retire clinical and population health solutions.
* **Establish portfolio performance and value-realization practices** that connect solution investments with clinical, quality, affordability, member-experience, operational, and business outcomes.
* **Identify and address portfolio-level risks and constraints**, coordinating mitigation plans, recommending corrective actions, and escalating material issues.
* **Provide executive portfolio decision support** through clear updates, scenario analyses, investment recommendations, and decision materials.

**Use your skills to make an impact**
=====================================

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree.
* Five (5) or more years of experience in healthcare portfolio management, enterprise program management with portfolio-level responsibilities, or management consulting.
* Experience developing data-driven business cases, scenario analyses, or investment recommendations that address expected outcomes, financial and resource requirements, implementation considerations, risks, and performance measures.
* Experience establishing or applying portfolio governance, prioritization, investment-planning, stage-gate, or solution-lifecycle practices.
* Experience developing portfolio-management tools, templates, workflows, or reporting processes that support consistent decision-making and execution.
* Experience developing integrated portfolio plans or roadmaps that address priorities, sequencing, resource requirements, dependencies, risks, and operational capacity.
* Experience establishing performance measures or evaluating value realization across clinical, quality, financial, member-experience, operational, or business outcomes.
* Experience leading cross-functional work and communicating recommendations to senior leaders in a complex, matrixed organization.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in business administration, healthcare administration, public health, health informatics, finance, clinical sciences, or a related field.
* Portfolio Management Professional (PfMP), Program Management Professional (PgMP), or another relevant portfolio-management certification.
* Experience in Medicaid managed care, including knowledge of Medicaid populations, state requirements, population health management, healthcare quality, health equity, and health-related social needs.
* Experience managing a portfolio of clinical solutions, population health programs, benefits, partnerships, products, or service models.
* Experience designing or implementing enterprise portfolio governance, stage-gate processes, product operating models, innovation practices, or portfolio-management offices.

**Additional Information**

* **Travel:** Up to 15%, including occasional travel, outside your state of residence for collaborative and team engagement meetings.
* **Work Schedule:** *Eastern Time Zone* with a flexible schedule, including occasional nights and weekends, as business needs require.

jobs.title: Program Delivery Lead, Benefit Enablement & Execution
jobs.description:
**Become a part of our caring community**
=========================================

Humana’s Consumer Product Management team is seeking an experienced Program Deliver Lead, Benefit Enablement & Execution, to join working remote anywhere in the US. In this role, you'll serve as a critical delivery connector across Insurance Product Management, Growth and Strategy, and the functional teams responsible for bringing Medicare Advantage products to market. You'll translate portfolio priorities into structured programs, clear milestones and coordinated workstreams that support accurate, timely and compliant execution. If you enjoy turning big-picture strategy into well-managed programs and helping teams deliver successfully, this role is for you.

As the Program Deliver Lead, Benefit Enablement & Execution, you'll lead complex bid initiatives and enterprise projects that span product strategy, benefit design, regulatory requirements, operational readiness, technology and process enablement. This includes coordinating initiatives such as benefit standardization, portfolio segmentation, plan naming, service area expansion and the evaluation of new product and benefit opportunities.

You'll also help strengthen how Product Management operates. You'll establish practical delivery disciplines, maintain governance and program documentation, improve processes and tools, and provide timely training as requirements change. Through research, analysis and cross-functional leadership, you'll help teams understand complex issues, evaluate implications and move toward clear, executable decisions.

This is a highly collaborative individual-contributor role for someone who can create clarity from ambiguity, lead complex work without relying on formal authority and keep multiple teams aligned through demanding Medicare Advantage and CMS delivery cycles.

**Key Role Functions**

**Lead Medicare Advantage Bid Initiatives**

* Partner with Growth and Strategy, Insurance Product Management and functional teams to define objectives, scope, deliverables, decision points and measures of success for bid-related initiatives
* Lead coordinated delivery of initiatives involving benefit standardization, portfolio segmentation, product guiding principles and other enterprise or portfolio priorities
* Translate strategic direction into executable workplans, milestones, dependencies, ownership and decision requirements
* Establish delivery approaches that create consistency across portfolios while allowing for appropriate product, market and regulatory differences
* Facilitate cross-functional discussions needed to evaluate options, surface tradeoffs and move initiatives toward timely decisions
* Monitor initiative progress and ensure key decisions, dependencies and risks are identified before they affect bid submissions or downstream implementation
* Capture lessons learned and incorporate them into future bid and product cycles

**Lead Feasibility Assessment and Decision Support**

* Lead structured evaluation of proposed products, benefits and portfolio opportunities across product, regulatory, operational, clinical, technology, system and financial considerations
* Define the questions, information and functional expertise needed to assess whether an opportunity can be executed accurately and within required timelines
* Bring together subject-matter experts to identify dependencies, constraints, assumptions, unresolved questions and downstream impacts
* Distinguish between identified facts, assumptions and areas requiring additional validation so leaders can make informed decisions
* Develop clear recommendations and decision-support materials that explain options, risks, tradeoffs and execution implications
* Facilitate alignment among partners with different priorities while recognizing that final product, financial or strategic decisions remain with the appropriate accountable leaders
* Maintain documentation of recommendations, decisions, rationale, owners and follow-up actions

**Lead Enterprise Research and Product Impact Analysis**

* Lead research and analysis related to Stars, Clinical, Regulatory Compliance, the Complaints Tracking Module and other enterprise priorities affecting Medicare Advantage products
* Identify relevant product, member, regulatory, operational and delivery implications
* Synthesize complex information into concise findings, recommendations and decision points for Product Management leaders and partner teams
* Evaluate how enterprise initiatives could affect benefit design, product processes, portfolio priorities, filings, systems or the member experience
* Serve as the Product Management program delivery lead on assigned enterprise initiatives
* Coordinate Product Management participation, consolidate feedback and ensure Product requirements and impacts are represented accurately
* Communicate conclusions, open questions and recommended actions in a format appropriate for working teams and senior leaders

**Own Program Governance and Delivery Discipline**

Remote Concierge Patient Care Coordinator

**Fully remote. Monday through Friday, 7:30 am to 4:00 pm Hawaii time. Open to candidates living in Arizona, Colorado, Idaho, Nevada, New Mexico, Oregon, Utah, Washington, or Wyoming.**

**About Makena Health**

Makena Health is a concierge medical practice in Wailea, Maui, where primary care, longevity medicine, and advanced therapeutics come together in one long-term relationship between each member and their physician.

Our mission is to extend healthspan and help people perform at their best for decades, through precise, evidence-driven concierge medicine built on long-term relationships and outcomes we can measure.

Six values guide how we work, and they are what we hire, review, and recognize against:

* **The member comes first, always.** Every member should feel personally known, prioritized, and never rushed, from the first inquiry to the last follow-up.
* **Excellence without compromise.** We hold every protocol, message, and care plan to a high standard, and we give each other direct feedback when something can be better.
* **We stay curious.** We keep up with emerging science and bring in evidence-based therapies when they fit what a member needs.
* **Compassion and full presence.** We listen before we act and remember what matters to each member, including their goals, their worries, and their family.
* **Integrity in every decision.** Recommendations are driven only by what is right for the member, and we are honest about what we know and what we don't.
* **Safety is non-negotiable.** Thorough screening comes before any advanced therapy, and raising a safety concern is expected of everyone on the team, never second-guessed.

Members join through an annual membership rather than insurance, which gives us the time to practice medicine the way we think it should be practiced. That means same or next-day appointments, unhurried visits, direct access to their physician, and messages that sound like a person wrote them. We borrow a lot from great hospitality, and we keep learning from it.

We are a small team and we plan to stay that way, so every member gets real attention. This role is the one that makes that promise hold up day to day.

**Role Mission**

Own the member experience from the day someone joins through every follow-up after, so no member ever has to chase us for a result, a referral, or a next step, and every member who should renew does.

This is a new seat on our team, and it is fully remote. You will work from home in the western U.S., stay closely connected to our team in Maui, and coordinate care for members across Hawaii and the mainland. You will help shape how the role works, write its playbook with us, and see the difference you make in members' lives every week.

You will report to our Practice Manager and work alongside our physician, clinical team, and operations team every day.

**Who We Are Looking For**

You notice the loose end before anyone asks about it. A lab result that came back on Friday, a specialist who never confirmed, a member whose renewal is three months out and who sounded quieter on their last call. You see those things and you close them, without being reminded.

You are usually the most organized person in the room. If friends call you Type A, you take it as a compliment. Your inbox is under control by the end of the day, your task list is always current, and you double-check the details other people skim, like the date of birth on a referral or the fax number on an order. A clean handoff and a closed loop give you real satisfaction, and a dropped ball bothers you long after everyone else has moved on.

You bring a hospitality instinct and an operator's follow-through in the same person. You can stay on the phone with a member who is anxious about a result and make them feel heard, then turn to your tracking sheet and run it with the same care.

You like being measured. Clear targets, honest feedback, and a manager who checks the numbers every month feel like respect to you, and you would rather know where you stand than guess.

You also do your best work without someone looking over your shoulder. You keep your own day organized, communicate early when something is stuck, and make a remote team feel like it sits in the same room.

In practice, that means someone with a medical background, such as a medical assistant, registered nurse, licensed clinical social worker, or experienced case manager, who brings:

* Meticulous attention to detail, including the habit of checking your own work before it goes out, so errors stop with you
* Exceptional organization across dozens of members at once, with a system you trust and can explain to someone else
* The instinct to anticipate what a member or physician will need next, and the follow-through to handle it before anyone asks
* Fluency with technology and the steadiness to stay sharp in a fast-moving, patient-centered practice
* Professionalism and discretion paired with critical thinking, so you can support members and physicians at a concierge standard of care

If you come from hospital case management, a medical office, or outpatient care coordination, much of this work will feel familiar. The difference is time. Here you will have a panel of members, no discharge pressure, and the room to know each person well.

**Responsibilities and Expectations**

Each of these is yours to own end to end.

**New member onboarding**

* Complete every new member's intake forms, consents, and outside records within 3 business days of signing, and book their first visit at the first available slot
* Make the first two weeks of membership feel personal and organized, with no member having to ask what happens next
* Work directly with the people who help manage a member's schedule when that is how the member prefers to be reached

**Follow-up and open loops**

* Track every lab, imaging study, referral, and follow-up order to closure, with zero lost or forgotten

Remote Concierge Patient Care Coordinator

**Fully remote. Monday through Friday, 7:30 am to 4:00 pm Hawaii time. Open to candidates living in Arizona, Colorado, Idaho, Nevada, New Mexico, Oregon, Utah, Washington, or Wyoming.**

**About Makena Health**

Makena Health is a concierge medical practice in Wailea, Maui, where primary care, longevity medicine, and advanced therapeutics come together in one long-term relationship between each member and their physician.

Our mission is to extend healthspan and help people perform at their best for decades, through precise, evidence-driven concierge medicine built on long-term relationships and outcomes we can measure.

Six values guide how we work, and they are what we hire, review, and recognize against:

* **The member comes first, always.** Every member should feel personally known, prioritized, and never rushed, from the first inquiry to the last follow-up.
* **Excellence without compromise.** We hold every protocol, message, and care plan to a high standard, and we give each other direct feedback when something can be better.
* **We stay curious.** We keep up with emerging science and bring in evidence-based therapies when they fit what a member needs.
* **Compassion and full presence.** We listen before we act and remember what matters to each member, including their goals, their worries, and their family.
* **Integrity in every decision.** Recommendations are driven only by what is right for the member, and we are honest about what we know and what we don't.
* **Safety is non-negotiable.** Thorough screening comes before any advanced therapy, and raising a safety concern is expected of everyone on the team, never second-guessed.

Members join through an annual membership rather than insurance, which gives us the time to practice medicine the way we think it should be practiced. That means same or next-day appointments, unhurried visits, direct access to their physician, and messages that sound like a person wrote them. We borrow a lot from great hospitality, and we keep learning from it.

We are a small team and we plan to stay that way, so every member gets real attention. This role is the one that makes that promise hold up day to day.

**Role Mission**

Own the member experience from the day someone joins through every follow-up after, so no member ever has to chase us for a result, a referral, or a next step, and every member who should renew does.

This is a new seat on our team, and it is fully remote. You will work from home in the western U.S., stay closely connected to our team in Maui, and coordinate care for members across Hawaii and the mainland. You will help shape how the role works, write its playbook with us, and see the difference you make in members' lives every week.

You will report to our Practice Manager and work alongside our physician, clinical team, and operations team every day.

**Who We Are Looking For**

You notice the loose end before anyone asks about it. A lab result that came back on Friday, a specialist who never confirmed, a member whose renewal is three months out and who sounded quieter on their last call. You see those things and you close them, without being reminded.

You are usually the most organized person in the room. If friends call you Type A, you take it as a compliment. Your inbox is under control by the end of the day, your task list is always current, and you double-check the details other people skim, like the date of birth on a referral or the fax number on an order. A clean handoff and a closed loop give you real satisfaction, and a dropped ball bothers you long after everyone else has moved on.

You bring a hospitality instinct and an operator's follow-through in the same person. You can stay on the phone with a member who is anxious about a result and make them feel heard, then turn to your tracking sheet and run it with the same care.

You like being measured. Clear targets, honest feedback, and a manager who checks the numbers every month feel like respect to you, and you would rather know where you stand than guess.

You also do your best work without someone looking over your shoulder. You keep your own day organized, communicate early when something is stuck, and make a remote team feel like it sits in the same room.

In practice, that means someone with a medical background, such as a medical assistant, registered nurse, licensed clinical social worker, or experienced case manager, who brings:

* Meticulous attention to detail, including the habit of checking your own work before it goes out, so errors stop with you
* Exceptional organization across dozens of members at once, with a system you trust and can explain to someone else
* The instinct to anticipate what a member or physician will need next, and the follow-through to handle it before anyone asks
* Fluency with technology and the steadiness to stay sharp in a fast-moving, patient-centered practice
* Professionalism and discretion paired with critical thinking, so you can support members and physicians at a concierge standard of care

If you come from hospital case management, a medical office, or outpatient care coordination, much of this work will feel familiar. The difference is time. Here you will have a panel of members, no discharge pressure, and the room to know each person well.

**Responsibilities and Expectations**

Each of these is yours to own end to end.

**New member onboarding**

* Complete every new member's intake forms, consents, and outside records within 3 business days of signing, and book their first visit at the first available slot
* Make the first two weeks of membership feel personal and organized, with no member having to ask what happens next
* Work directly with the people who help manage a member's schedule when that is how the member prefers to be reached

**Follow-up and open loops**
